_comment: Controlled vocabulary for the topicId field on native question-bank items. One entry per physics topic, independent of any course's unit numbering. build/validate.js checks every bank item's topicId against this list and confirms the item's courses are a subset of the topic's declared courses. Prose rationale and the conversion workflow live in docs/question-bank-topics.md.

kinematics-1d.title: One-dimensional kinematics
kinematics-1d.scope: Motion language, position/velocity/acceleration-time graphs, constant-acceleration equations, 1-D free fall, vector components and SOHCAHTOA. No projectile motion, force-based reasoning, or calculus.

forces-and-newtons-laws.title: Forces and Newton's laws (introductory)
forces-and-newtons-laws.scope: Gravity (universal gravitation), inertia and Newton's first law, force identification and free-body diagrams, equilibrium, Newton's second law, inclined planes (with and without friction), Newton's third law, Hooke's law. 1-D net-force reasoning and simple inclines; no 2-D vector force addition beyond incline components.
